selection: All 18 forecast/warning lexical titles plus one observation/review and one unclassified per calendar quarter, seed 20261002. No spending data read.
purpose: Estimate title-to-body information loss and manually audit topic/scope on a stratified sample; no population precision estimate from unweighted strata.
rule_for_forecast_comparison: Do not train a hazard model from incompletely sampled bodies or treat omitted events as zero. Any subsequent forecasting experiment must use a separately frozen complete feature source.
exclusions: Full body not used as historical as-of evidence if article date disagrees with index; unknown revisions remain a limitation.
